audit_comment: THE MM2 INDEX WALK - the merged MM1/FF/MM2 index (print pp. 156-160, the gap box label says p. 156, the printed page numbers in both scans give the five-page span; the 4-column layout, the 26 letter sections). THE OPENING DOCTRINE (p. 156, pinned as the consts and bools): the index includes all official creatures (as of December, 1982) published in this volume as well as the MONSTER MANUAL and FIEND FOLIO; the left-hand column gives the book and page where each may be found, M for MONSTER MANUAL I, F for FIEND FOLIO, no letter if the creature is detailed in this book; a listing in parentheses to the right of the entry indicates the name under which it is found. THE METHOD: a two-voice adjudication - both archive.org djvu scans parsed independently (the column reconstruction, the ref-token split, the registry cross-resolve), junk-filtered, paired per letter by global-best matching; the 206 single-voice slots adjudicated by hand, the ref-fused M and F OCR lines re-lettered to their true sections, the split fragments dropped. THE PIN: a line census, not a def census - 1488 adjudicated index lines (577 MM1 references, 401 FF references, 510 this-book lines, 470 parenthetical cross-references); the within-letter double-listings retained as separate print lines (the dragons double-listed, the inverted cross-refs). THE SETTLED RECLASS READS: the Leprechaun, Salt Water Troll, Troll and Weasel lines carry M references the OCR lost (4); the Sirme line (between the Singing Ape and Skeleton rows) reclassified the MM2 sirine, the Stalker line (between the Stag Beetle and Dark Stalker rows) the reference lost in both scans - both flagged (2). THE B-ONLY REAL ENTRIES: the Caryatid Column and Olhydra lines - no registry def, the OA/lammasu promotion seam stays queued. NO defs promoted this round; the registry stays 809. THE FLIPS: the Random Encounter Tables parent box closes riding the landed R816/R817/R818 children, and the Index box closes - the MM2 arc gap ends 37 closed, 0 open.
